string.text: Registers HUD v3.3 as the preferred passive Check display. It never captures input.
Live Feedback shows mechanical detail. Minimal Immersion emphasizes state and contextual thoughts.
Shows or hides the GAIN, LOSS, TOTAL, modifier, cap, lock and Combat Stress diagnostic text when Check Composure is pressed. It fades with the bar.
Shows the segmented Composure bar when Check Composure is pressed. This replaces the old separate Live and Minimal bar switches.
Shows the exact 0-100 value beside the status description.
Shows one to five left loss arrows or right gain arrows beside the segmented bar.
Minimalist Check is the compact default. Detailed diagnostics adds the mechanical report below it.
Minimalist Check is the first and default option. Detailed diagnostics adds the mechanical report below it.
This legacy option is no longer exposed or read. The HUD is always check-triggered.
Shows the continuous color-coded composure bar.
Shows aggregate and per-cause composure rates per real minute.
Shows active modifier sources in Live Feedback. Disable for a cleaner testing panel.
Maximum number of strongest distinct modifiers shown in the compact panel, from one to eight.
Detailed: show Combat Stress test details
Shows phase, encounter, hostiles, threat, sustained drain, deferred loss, encounter loss, start value, recovery lock, and forced phase while Combat is active or in Test Mode.
Shows the exact value in Minimal Immersion mode. Disabled by default.
Shows a subdued color-coded bar beneath the state.
Shows one to five left arrows for loss or right arrows for gain. The bar remains fixed in the centre.
Shows or hides the text above the bar in both Minimalist Check and Detailed diagnostics modes.
Briefly colors the bar green or red after an instant gain or loss without changing the ongoing trend arrows.
Seconds for the Check display to fade smoothly to full opacity.
Seconds the Check display remains fully visible before fading out.
Seconds for the Check display to fade smoothly away.
How frequently the visible panel requests a fresh Framework snapshot.
Seconds used to smooth the net ongoing rate and prevent arrow flicker.
Absolute Composure per minute treated as stable with no arrows.
Seconds a new direction must persist before arrows switch sides.
Rates up to this absolute Composure per minute show one arrow.
Rates above level one and up to this value show two arrows.
Rates above level two and up to this value show three arrows.
Rates above level three and up to this value show four arrows. Higher rates show five.
Moves the complete top-centre Check display left or right.
Moves the complete Check display up or down.
Development option. Allows configured keys to change Composure through Framework while bypassing gameplay multipliers and recovery locks. Disabled by default.
Shows the temporary Composure HUD. Default: F10. This replaces the retired Composure Main check binding.
Composure points added or removed per tester key press. Default: 3.
Default key: minus. Applies the negative tester adjustment during normal gameplay.
Default key: equals. Applies the positive tester adjustment during normal gameplay.
Writes additional HUD registration and mode information to the X-Ray log. Display failures are always logged.
